Kara L (cs-ops): quick flag 3 accounts from the Oct import have health_score == 0 instead of null. Playbook sent renewal nudges. Can we pause nudges for imported trials while we check? :eyes:
Dev R (data): I can run a scoped recompute. Dry run first: `./bin/recompute --cohort=2024-10-20:2024-10-31 --dry`
Maya P (cs): I've messaged the reps to hold outbound for that cohort. Thanks.
Owen T (eng): Found the cause: feature-api returns [] for missing hist metrics, scorer treats [] as 0. I'll push a patch to treat empty as null.
Kara L (cs-ops): Can someone add a short-lived playbook rule to suppress renewal nudges where `health_score == 0 && source == "import"` until backfill completes?
Maya P (cs): Added temporary rule in Console: id=suppress-import-zero-2024, expires=2024-11-08. PlaybookBot confirmed.
PlaybookBot: Playbook update accepted: suppress-import-zero-2024 (applied by Maya P). :white_check_mark:
Dev R (data): Dry run recompute shows 9/13 would get non-zero scores. I'll apply now and post results.
Dev R (data): Applied recompute: updated=9, unchanged=4. Removed updated accounts from suppression.
Owen T (eng): Patch merged: treat empty feature arrays as null. Will roll in next deploy window.
Kara L (cs-ops): Great teamwork. I'll log INCIDENT-2024-11-import-score-gap and close once deploy is prod.
